ALS.initialization: truncated ordinary float64 SVD; singular values split by square root
ALS.objective: min ||tril(A - U V^T)||_F^2; residual A-S for named_plus_masked
ALS.gauge: QR of both factors then SVD of the small product each sweep; balanced factors; algebraically preserves U V^T
ALS.solver: well-conditioned Gram solve plus observed-residual refinement; otherwise direct design SVD least squares
ALS.numerical_sweep_policy: If objective increases by >1e-9*max(1,previous), retry whole sweep with direct LS; if still increasing retain previous finite factors and record rejection; always attempt all 200 sweeps
ALS.convergence: normalized gradient<=1e-6 AND (last20 relative loss change<=1e-7 OR relative error<=1e-6); rejected sweeps count as nonconverged unless error<=1e-6

matrix_sampling.design: six equal-width layer strata per document; offset cycles systematically over all layers across documents; uniformly random archived head within chosen document/layer, seed=50+model_index

diagonal.criterion: median over ALL archived matrices of each head of max(mean-row offset0 mass,mean-row offset1 mass)) > 0.9
diagonal.offset1_first_row: zero (no previous token); both sums divided by n=128

storage.a_d: SVD cost K*(2n+1); named S cost 2*active_atoms plus (K-1)*(2n+1)
storage.b_c: masked cost 2*n*K; named S cost 2*active_atoms plus 2*n*(K-1)
storage.e_f: same rank cap on reconstructed heads; identical heads kept exact in both ablations (extra exact-head storage, not a globally fixed-cap compression claim)

statistics.primary: phase24.describe instance median; 2000 whole-document bootstrap samples, seed0
statistics.paired: per-instance differences -> median per document -> two-sided Wilcoxon, wilcox zeros, asymptotic p; signed rank-biserial positive favors right arm
statistics.matrix_reference: fp16 archived A normalized by imported harness in float64; raw pre-normalization objective also retained

sanities.planted: n=128, ranks8/16, seed5001, positive lognormal(0,0.7) factors, row-normalized; 200 sweeps, relative recovery tolerance 0.01 declared before running
sanities.CPU_GPU: 32 matrices/model, first selected matrix in documents0..31, both K and plain/named residual; compare GPU double against independent CPU double fits and identical initial factors; report maximum raw and normalized error difference
sanities.baseline_reuse: all256 article identities/targets/batches/dtypes/reference NLL matched; V1 SVD observations agree exactly with E4 reused SVD; rerun firstbatch all K a/d with max KL/NLL discrepancy<=2e-5
sanities.identity: native eager and imported identity logits exactly equal; KL exactly0
